method: Unchanged scripts/solo-probe.mjs tactical beam search. Default five-slot loadouts, no growth rewards. Every committed action and an independent replay use only public battle operations; all live snapshots pass normalizeSave.
limitations: Search values every secondary-resource unit at 1.8, so role-specific setup can be undervalued.
This is deterministic automated play, not player win rate. Wider failed-case rechecks are separate attempts.
The unchanged score does not assign value to AP carry, and none of these default-width plans retained AP; these runs do not evaluate the tactical value of saving AP for a later burst.
